test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. **

Obesity is also a progressive condition, unlike anorexia nervosa, which tends to ______ with age.
solution: The correct answer is **"ameliorate".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Ameliorate" **means to improve or make something better. ((स्थिति आदि) सुधारना, बेहतर करना) • **Example**: *Steps have been taken to **ameliorate**__ the situation.* • The sentence is saying that anorexia nervosa tends to not improve with age, while obesity is a progressive condition that can potentially be improved. • The word **"progressive"** in the sentence suggests that obesity gets worse over time, but **"ameliorate"** implies that it can be slowed or reversed. • So, the correct answer is **Option 2**. **Correct sentence:** *Obesity is also a progressive condition, unlike anorexia nervosa, which tends to __**ameliorate**__ with age.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **"Inebriate"** means to make someone drunk or intoxicated (किसी को नशे में धुत्त करना). This doesn't make sense in the context of the sentence. • **"Struggle"** means to have difficulty or work hard to achieve something (कोई (विशेषतः कठिन) काम करने के लिए कठोर प्रयास करना). This doesn't fit with the comparison being made between anorexia nervosa and obesity. • **"Negate"** means to nullify or cancel something out (बेअसर या अशक्त करना; बेकार करना; निष्फल करना). This doesn't make sense in the context of the sentence. 1c4:T9a6, The correct answer is **Option 4**.
